nodes.text: As though that wasn't enough, by March 11th, WHO declared COVID-19 a https://t.co/ZOjn5AQQ3r March 30th, there was Lockdown in Nigeria and which lasted for months, from Partial Lockdown to Total Lockdown starting from the FCT and Lagos even finally affecting every state.

nodes.text:
COVID-19 changed the cause of things in the world forever, it was that time that Zoom become very popular because all our learning were taken to zoom. 

As at December 30th, 2024, WHO said that there has been over 7 million deaths due to COVID-19 since the outbreak in 2019.

nodes.author: MMDTV_01
nodes.text: Now from the stable of the Northern Chinese provinces, there arise yet another seemingly common flu which is yet again spreading fast and having similar symptoms as COVID-19, this is is Called Human MetaPneumovirus (HMPV).

nodes.author: MMDTV_01
nodes.text:
Or should we call it #Meta-24?. I think #Meta-24 is great a name for this rising unclassified pandemic. 

Taiwan’s Centers for Disease Control has said the virus’s higher risks for children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals.

nodes.author: MMDTV_01
nodes.text:
In neighbouring India, officials said there is no need for panic as HMPV is “like any other respiratory virus”.

Even as we move daily, I urge us all to maintain all hygienic principles. Love your neighbor but don't contact their common flu even if it's not #Meta-24.
